title: Kissed Norwegian Lamb Kebabs
description: A keto-friendly Norwegian dish featuring lamb kebabs with a hint of golden syrup, perfect for a date night, with an earthy and aerated flavor profile, the lamb is first soaked in a brine solution to enhance the tenderness and flavor.

ingredients.name: brine solution
ingredients.notes: 1/2 cup water, 1/2 cup kosher salt, 1/4 cup brown sugar

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the brine solution ingredients until the salt and sugar are dissolved.
Add the lamb cubes to the brine solution and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together the golden syrup, coconut oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Brush the syrup mixture evenly onto both sides of the lamb kebabs.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice.
